A statement start to the tournament!
Brescia Lions kicked off their 2026 campaign in style, cruising to a dominant 61-run victory over Milan Icons in the tournament opener!
A commanding performance from the Lions saw them come out on top in a rain-shortened 7-overs-a-side contest at the Roma Cricket Ground!
